- Removed begin from back-spin (sha 2cb6272b... → f1e3d31e...): activeAnimations=["back-spin"], wheel-back moving.
- Removed begin from front-spin (f1e3d31e... → ab09adb7...): activeAnimations=["back-spin","front-spin"], wheel-front moving.
- Removed begin from pedal-spin (ab09adb7... → 60459cf2...): final verify reports passed=true, activeAnimations=["back-spin","front-spin","pedal-spin"], all three groups moving, geometryPreserved=true, no errors/warnings.

Only the begin attributes changed; ids, dur, from/to rotate targets, and every geometric element are preserved."}
